transitions.trigger: a harness opens a session and runs the session-start script, or the agent runs it after a nudge
the digest finishes every stage inside its runtime bound
transitions.guard: the per-home session lock is acquired and verified

transitions.trigger: the lock script cannot acquire and verify the session lock
transitions.guard: the recorded owner is another live harness, or the state directory cannot be written
transitions.failure: session lock refused (exit 1); the session reports the diagnostic and makes no fleet change

transitions.trigger: the digest child stops on its runtime bound or dies
transitions.failure: digest truncated: the banner names the stage that did not finish and the sections never emitted (exit 124 for the runtime bound, another status for a death)

changes: the agent may raise FM_SESSION_START_TIMEOUT before the rerun

transitions.trigger: the agent reruns the session-start script after the banner
the agent has reconciled this home's recorded direct reports with the digest
the agent finds a recorded direct report whose endpoint is dead or whose metadata has no window
transitions.guard: the report is recorded in this home; its worktree and unlanded work are preserved
transitions.failure: ordinary direct report dead after a restart; recovered through the stuck-crewmate-recovery skill

changes: the recorded worktree and unlanded work are kept

transitions.trigger: a watcher close or a durable queue append publishes the downtime marker
transitions.guard: no live watcher with a fresh beacon inside the 300-second grace
transitions.failure: watcher cycle ended without a live successor

retry.backoff: exponential, 250 ms base, capped at 4000 ms (Pi and OpenCode adapters)
changes: a fresh arm attempt starts after the delay
the downtime marker keeps its generation until it is acknowledged

transitions.trigger: a re-arm owner starts a verified successor watcher and the drain acknowledges the episode
transitions.guard: the acknowledgement names the current recovery generation and no queue rows remain

transitions.trigger: the captain enters away or quiet mode, and the script writes the posture record in the same turn
the captain's first unmarked message archives the away record
transitions.guard: an away record exists and the message is not marked

transitions.trigger: the captain invokes the update command or asks to update firstmate
the update script finishes its pass over the running home and every registered secondmate home
transitions.guard: fast-forward only, never force, merge commit or stash; a skipped home gets no action; a live mate whose runtime can prove a restart is restarted whether or not its files changed

transitions.trigger: the watcher probe finds a registered secondmate's endpoint dead or missing
transitions.guard: relaunch attempts inside the 3600-second window are below 3, and the endpoint is proven dead or missing
transitions.failure: secondmate endpoint dead or missing; relaunched through the guarded spawn path with one check wake

changes: a replacement agent starts in the recorded endpoint
an attempt line is appended to the per-mate ledger

transitions.trigger: the relaunch attempts of one mate inside the window reach the bound
transitions.guard: attempts inside the 3600-second window are at or above 3

transitions.trigger: a later live probe finds the parked mate alive
transitions.guard: the park marker for that mate exists

transitions.trigger: the armed daily growth check finds the startup memory over its allowance or a file grown past its threshold
transitions.guard: the finding differs from the one last reported; the check evaluates at most once per day

transitions.trigger: the harness process that owns the session ends, by exit or by a crash

failures.name: a lock-refused session has no documented exit except a later session start; the cited text gives no bound on how long it stays read-only
a harness with no compaction channel (Codex's interactive UI, a Cursor primary) loses the digest on compaction and nothing re-emits it
a home skipped by the update stays on old bytes until a later update or bootstrap pass surfaces its durable divergence record
no source states a time limit on how long a home may stay without a live session after a crash

shared_resources: the watcher singleton and its beacon
a secondmate's endpoint and relaunch ledger
serialized_by: one session lock per home, owned by one harness pid
concurrency.on_conflict: session lock refused: the session is read-only and reports the diagnostic; a relaunch lock held by another supervisor: the caller skips and lets that episode finish

touchpoints.no_answer: none found: away mode holds captain decisions for the captain's return, and the cited text sets no deadline after which firstmate decides alone; destructive, irreversible and security-sensitive actions are never pre-authorizable
none found: an update starts only when the captain invokes it or asks; the cited text names no timer or default that starts one
